instruction: Ticket RAA1323601591_S001_DU03_010-10047-aniCellDown-aniCellDown-TotsukaCDC: (gnb_id 4522435, du_id 3, cell_id 10, data center TotsukaCDC, prefecture/cluster TOKYO-TO) is reporting: {'aniCellLastFailure': 'softwarefailure', 'OperStatus': 'down'}. How do I troubleshoot and resolve this issue?

task_plan: From NOC / jump server, verify DU/NGDU management reachability before any deeper DU checks.
Inside DU/NGDU, check DU software health and identify any crashed/missing pods contributing to aniCellDown.
Check for Application DOWN indications and correlate with pod restarts/crashes around the event time to confirm software failure path.
Inside DU host, check for snapshots, sysmon reboot/healthcheck failures, watchdog/power cycle, or processor/configuration errors around the event time.
Inside master confd pod, verify cell operational state, sector carrier state, RU/ORU state, administrative state, and DU-F1C connectivity; map failure path based on observed states.
Inside notifmgr pod, correlate alarm sequence around event time and use the first alarm in sequence as the RCA driver to trigger corresponding subissue SOP and escalation path.

actions.action: DU Reachability. From NOC / jump server, verify DU/NGDU management reachability before any deeper DU checks. Command(s): 'ping6 <DU_MGMT_IP> -c 4'. Expected: PASS: 0% packet loss / DU reachable. FAIL: 100% packet loss or no route to host. If it fails: subissue: Host unreachable / network or site issue; action: Classify as host unreachable / network or site issue.; action: Check BMC reachability if applicable.; action: Escalate to Cloud / RCP / Field or IP team.; action: Stop further DU checks until reachability is restored.; escalate: Cloud / RCP / Field or IP team; stop

Kubernetes Pods Check. Inside DU/NGDU, check DU software health and identify any crashed/missing pods contributing to aniCellDown. Command(s): 'kubectl get pods -A'; 'kubectl get pods -o wide | grep -i <GNB_DU>'. Expected: PASS: All DU application pods are Running and expected ready counts are healthy. FAIL: CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, Init, Terminating, Pending, missing pod, or all pods not found. If it fails: subissue: Crashed/missing DU application pods; action: For crashed/missing pods, capture pod name and invoke software RCA/RMOP path.; action: If cells are inactive after recovery, redeploy DU apps or escalate to DU Software / L2.; escalate: DU Software / L2 (if cells inactive after recovery or redeploy needed)

Application DOWN / Software Crash Check. Check for Application DOWN indications and correlate with pod restarts/crashes around the event time to confirm software failure path. Command(s): 'kubectl get pods -o wide | grep -i <GNB_DU>'; 'cat /var/log/ani/notifmgr.log | grep -i "Application DOWN indication received for App"'. Expected: PASS: No application down and pods are stable. FAIL: Application DOWN indication or restarted/crashed pod around event time. If it fails: subissue: Application DOWN indication / software crash; action: Invoke software RCA/RMOP.; action: Capture pod name.; action: Redeploy DU apps if cells remain IDLE.; escalate: DU Software / L2 (software RCA/RMOP path)

Platform / Hardware Check. Inside DU host, check for snapshots, sysmon reboot/healthcheck failures, watchdog/power cycle, or processor/configuration errors around the event time. Command(s): 'ls -lrth /rs_obsrv/snapshots_push_failure/ | grep "<DATE>"'; 'grep -i "reboot triggered" /var/log/arc/sysmon/sysmonRebootInfo.txt | tail -5'; 'ipmitool sel list | grep -i "Processor|Watchdog|Power cycle" | grep "<DATE>"'. Expected: PASS: No snapshot, no sysmon reboot entry, no watchdog or processor error at event time. FAIL: Snapshot present, sysmon healthcheck failure, BMC watchdog, power cycle, processor/configuration error. If it fails: subissue: Platform/hardware related event evidence; action: Map platform issue.; action: Capture RCA evidence (snapshot/sysmon/ipmitool entries).; action: Escalate to platform/hardware/cloud team based on evidence.; escalate: Platform/Hardware/Cloud team (based on evidence)

Cell State and ORU State Check. Inside master confd pod, verify cell operational state, sector carrier state, RU/ORU state, administrative state, and DU-F1C connectivity; map failure path based on observed states. Command(s): 'cd ASN_log_collection_script/'; 'sh ConfdPodCli.sh duapp-<GNB_DU>-nrconfd-01'; 'sh ConfdPodCli.sh duapp-<GNB_DU>-nrconfd-02'; '/opt/ani/bin/confd_cli -A $ANI_CONFD_SERVICE_IPADDRESS -P $ANI_CONFD_SERVICE_PORT -u root'; 'show nr-cell'; 'show nr-sector-carrier'; 'show rumgr-state'; 'show configuration | match administrativeState'; 'show du-f1c'; 'request ue-stats'. Expected: PASS: NRCELL_DU_ACTIVE, NRSECTOR_CARRIER_TRANSMITTING, RU_TIMING_LOCKED, administrativeState UNLOCKED, DU-F1C complete/connected. FAIL: NRCELL_DU_IDLE, NRSECTOR_CARRIER_BASEBAND_CONFIGURED, RU_WAIT_FOR_CALL_HOME, administrativeState LOCKED, or DU-F1C down. If it fails: subissue: Cell/Carrier/RU/Admin/F1C state abnormal; action: Map failure per KB: RU_WAIT_FOR_CALL_HOME to fronthaul; F1C down to midhaul/CU; LOCKED to administrative; IDLE with timing issue to timing path.; escalate: Unavailable in provided KB (specific team/escalation for these mapped paths not explicitly documented)

notifmgr Log Correlation. Inside notifmgr pod, correlate alarm sequence around event time and use the first alarm in sequence as the RCA driver to trigger corresponding subissue SOP and escalation path. Command(s): 'kubectl get pods | grep -i "notifmgr"'; 'kubectl exec -it <NOTIFMGR_POD> -- bash'; 'cat /var/log/ani/notifmgr.log | grep -Ei "<MANAGED_ELEMENT_OR_CELL_PATH>|Application DOWN indication received for App" | grep -Ei "<EVENT_TIME_PLUS_MINUS_15_MIN>" | grep -Eib -m 20 "notifAniRuConnectivityOk|notifAniTimingUnlocked|notifAniCoolingFanBroken|aniNoExternalSyncSource|notifAniRuConnectivityFailure|notifAniCertAboutToExpire|aniInterfaceFault|Application DOWN indication received|notifAniTiminglocked|aniTemperatureFailure|softwarefailure|aniCellDown|aniOperationWarning|midhaulfailure|mgmtoperation|lbmfailure"'. Expected: PASS: Recovery sequence such as notifAniTimingLocked and notifAniRuConnectivityOk, with cells recovered. FAIL: First alarm maps to timing, fronthaul, midhaul, software crash, radio issue, certificate, cooling fan, operation warning, or unknown path. If it fails: subissue: First alarm indicates non-recovered or alternate RCA path; action: Use first alarm in sequence as RCA driver.; action: Trigger corresponding subissue SOP and escalation path.; escalate: Unavailable in provided KB (specific escalation per subissue not explicitly listed beyond software/platform reachability guidance)

verification: Pods stable and Running; no new Application DOWN around event; cells active and carriers transmitting; DU app redeploy/restart action documented where applicable; RCA captured from software RMOP or pod evidence.
